scripts.features:
ZekeHub Mass Farm is a paid Murder Mystery 2 farm built to run many accounts at once, all controlled from the web dashboard at zekehub.com. Built and maintained by the ZekeHub team since 2024.

HOW TO USE
1. Buy a key at https://zekehub.com/pricing?game=mm2 (priced by how many accounts you run at once)
2. Paste your key between the quotes in getgenv().scriptkey=""
3. Run the script on each account and manage them all from your dashboard

FARMING
- Farms coins and event currencies
- Server Hop when earnings in a time window drop below your threshold

ITEMS AND TRADING
- Auto Buy with available currencies
- Auto Salvage matching items and Auto Craft recipes in priority order
- Auto Trade to listed players, by item or rarity

BATTLE PASS
- Auto Battle Pass claims and buys tiers, collects the final reward and handles gifts

ACCOUNTS AND PERFORMANCE
- Web dashboard with live stats and config sync at zekehub.com/dashboard/mm2
- Account Manager swaps or kicks accounts when triggers are met, routed by whether the account has a Godly
- Discord webhook with farm stats
- Stats overlay and FPS cap to run more accounts per PC

DATA NOTICE
The farm sends each account's Roblox username, inventory and farm stats to your ZekeHub dashboard so you can manage your accounts. Keys are bought and managed on zekehub.com.
